purpose: Implement a provider-neutral ordered Recipe planning chassis so bounded multi-step producer jobs preserve capability, declared future authority, explicit postconditions and recovery expectations across studios without becoming blind macros or executing anything.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect and plan one bounded ordered producer job across studios while every step preserves capability truth, declared authority class, postconditions and recovery expectations and no authority is granted or host action executed.
lineage.capability: Composable host-neutral N0TE Recipe definition plus truthful per-studio plan

legacy_candidates: multi-step producer-job/recipe semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: RecipeDefinition preserves declared semantic step order and rejects duplicate step IDs
each step declares a supported authority class, at least one explicit postcondition and a supported recovery policy
dependencies may reference only earlier step IDs, rejecting forward, unknown and cyclic dependency shapes before planning
Recipe structural fields contain no host, provider, candidate, track, plug-in, approval or authorization identity
stable N0TEable job IDs derive from Recipe/step identity and the same Recipe may resolve through different legitimate routes in different Studio profiles
all steps resolved returns READY; any unavailable step returns UNAVAILABLE with exact per-step resolver reason codes
unverified installed-tool identity cannot satisfy a Recipe step and user constraints are delegated to the existing resolver
authority_class remains declaration-only metadata and RecipePlan exposes no approval, authorization, executed or receipt state
host label and brand changes cannot alter plan results when explicit candidate facts are unchanged
planning is deterministic and pure with no persistence, host mutation, provider call, transaction, postcondition assertion or recovery action
non_scope: host macros or DAW click automation
next_selection_rule: After CORE-03D evidence, reconcile and audit REQ-SCOPE-111 semantic owned-tool identity as the likely final CORE-03 foundation gap. Do not execute Recipes or select a DAW adapter by adjacency.
